subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should this issue be resolved with top-level `detail` parser support only, or should OpenClaw also suppress/no-reply unconfigured OpenAI/Codex provider failures at the routing boundary?
rationale: The parser gap is source-reproducible, but silently discarding unconfigured-provider failures changes user-visible diagnostics and provider-routing behavior.

options.title: Parser plus routing policy
options.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and add owner-approved tests for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches chat while diagnostics remain internal.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land the narrow `detail` parser/test fix now and track silent unconfigured-provider suppression as a separate product-policy issue.

options.title: Document generic failure policy
options.body: Keep generic user-facing provider failures and decline silent discard unless maintainers confirm that unconfigured-provider errors should be invisible.

recommendation.title: Parser plus routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and add owner-approved tests for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches chat while diagnostics remain internal.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored adjacent provider-error handling and are the clearest routing owner for the remaining policy choice.
